card.line: The Valley of Salt is a valley south of the Dead Sea where Israel and Judah won great battles against Edom, under David and later under Amaziah.

moments.title: David Defeats Edom
moments.text: David made a name for himself when 18,000 Edomites were struck down in the Valley of Salt. He placed garrisons in Edom, and the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.

moments.title: Abishai Strikes Down Edomites
moments.text: Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. All the Edomites became subject to David.

moments.title: Amaziah's Victory Over Edom
moments.text: King Amaziah of Judah led his troops to the Valley of Salt and struck down 10,000 men of Seir. He also took Sela in battle and renamed it Joktheel.

moments.title: Amaziah Turns to False Gods
moments.text: After the battle, Amaziah brought back the gods of the Seirites and bowed to them. The anger of the LORD burned against him, and He sent a prophet to warn him.
